newsitem.title: USA: CBOT, TSE tentatively agree to list JGBs in Chicago.
newsitem.headline: CBOT, TSE tentatively agree to list JGBs in Chicago.

text.p: A Chicago Board of Trade official confirmed CBOT and Tokyo Stock Exchange reached a tentative agreement allowing CBOT to trade TSE's 10-year Japanese government bond (JGB) contract.
"There is a tentative agreement out there, but we have nothing signed," the official said, adding CBOT directors approved the tentative agreement at last week's board meeting.
"We are continuing to look at other places, not only in that part of the world, but in other places as well," the source added.
